decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to use various artifacts and spells to enable the combo and generate a large amount of mana quickly. By using cards like Mishra's Bauble, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Lotus Petal, along with cards like Echo of Eons and Grapeshot, the deck aims to create explosive turns and win the game in a single burst of activity. The presence of defense cards like Defense Grid and Containment Construct help protect the combo pieces and facilitate the deck's path to victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Cephalid Breakfast combo, utilizing cards like Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill your library, Narcomoeba to bring back creatures from the graveyard, and Dread Return to reanimate a key combo piece such as Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and buy time to assemble it. Additionally, the deck leverages Urza's Saga to tutor for key combo pieces and generate additional value.

The deck focuses on controlling the game using powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler, along with disruptive cards like Force of Will and Counterbalance. Stoneforge Mystic is utilized to search for key equipment like Batterskull and Kaldra Compleat, while True-Name Nemesis provides a hard-to-answer threat. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Swords to Plowshares, as well as card selection and manipulation tools like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base is designed to support the deck's diverse color requirements and enable powerful plays.

This deck focuses on quickly getting out powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield by using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Lotus Petal. By utilizing fast mana sources like City of Traitors and Simian Spirit Guide, along with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game. The deck is built around the idea of cheating out expensive creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with powerful plays.

This deck focuses on efficiently ramping up mana with Cloudpost and Tron lands to quickly cast powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Eldrazi creatures. It also utilizes cards like Crop Rotation and Expedition Map to tutor for key lands like The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale or Eye of Ugin. The deck has strong control elements with cards like Pithing Needle and Reclamation Sage to disrupt opponents and protect its own strategy. The toolbox nature of the deck allows it to adapt to different matchups and outmaneuver opponents with its versatile land base and creature toolbox.

The deck relies on a combination of control elements such as counterspells, removal, and card advantage to outvalue the opponent. It also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value and synergies with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Staff of the Storyteller. The mana base is focused on fetching the necessary colors for spells and utilizing cards like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outlast the opponent through card advantage and powerful synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Spell Pierce, and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage with Narset, Parter of Veils and Brainstorm. The inclusion of Snapcaster Mage allows for additional value by recasting key spells from the graveyard. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the red, white, and blue spells in the deck while also enabling powerful synergies with cards like Mystic Sanctuary.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the necessary combo pieces (Show and Tell, Omniscience) and cheat out powerful, game-ending creatures (Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, Griselbrand, Atraxa, Grand Unifier) onto the battlefield without paying their mana costs. The deck aims to use cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, Preordain, and Force of Will to dig through the deck efficiently, while also employing counter spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces. With the ability to win the game in just a few turns, this deck focuses on speed and explosiveness to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb, Faithless Looting, and Unmask, then bring them back into play with Reanimate spells such as Animate Dead and Exhume. The key strategy is to utilize the graveyard as a resource for powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, taking advantage of their abilities to dominate the opponent. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Grief to control the opponent's hand, giving the combo pieces time to come together for a decisive victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence by utilizing artifacts and blue spells to generate card advantage and mana acceleration. By combining aggressive creature threats like Sai, Master Thopterist and Emry, Lurker of the Loch with disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan. The inclusion of powerful artifact lands like Urza's Saga and Seat of the Synod enhances the deck's synergy and overall power level.

The main objective of this deck is to control the opponent's board while ramping up mana through Gaea's Cradle, allowing for powerful plays like casting Craterhoof Behemoth. The deck includes a mix of creatures such as Grist, the Hunger Tide and Allosaurus Shepherd to provide protection and disruption. Utilizing cards like Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith, the deck aims to find key threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Endurance to further establish board presence. Overall, the deck focuses on leveraging mana advantage and powerful creatures to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a Legacy format.

The deck focuses on assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo using Cephalid Illusionist, Nomads en-Kor, and a way to repeatedly target the Illusionist to mill the entire library. This combo is supported by protection spells like Force of Will and Daze, along with card selection spells like Ponder and Brainstorm. Additionally, the deck includes interaction with Cabal Therapy and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as alternate win conditions such as Thassa's Oracle and Kaldra Compleat. The goal is to quickly set up and execute the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire deck in one turn. It uses artifact synergy with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga to generate mana and draw cards efficiently. The deck also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to disrupt the opponent while assembling the combo for a quick and decisive win.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana and card advantage in order to assemble a powerful storm combo. By utilizing cards like Lion's Eye Diamond, Lotus Petal, and Dark Ritual, the deck can generate large amounts of black mana to cast multiple spells in a single turn. Cards like Duress, Cabal Therapy, and Thoughtseize help disrupt the opponent's plans while searching for key combo pieces like Tendrils of Agony or Ad Nauseam. Wishclaw Talisman and Infernal Tutor provide additional tutor effects to find the necessary cards to win the game.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Cloudpost and Tron lands, while controlling the opponent's plays with cards like Stifle and Crop Rotation. The deck aims to use its mana advantage to play powerful threats like Primeval Titan, Ulamog, Emrakul, and Endurance to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Glacial Chasm and Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale also helps to stall the game and disrupt the opponent's strategies. Additionally, the deck can search for specific lands and creatures using Expedition Map, Green Sun's Zenith, and Elvish Reclaimer.

The deck focuses on using Death's Shadow as a powerful threat that can be quickly deployed with Reanimate or be powered up by lowering your own life total. It includes disruption in the form of discard spells like Thoughtseize, counterspells like Force of Will, and removal like Snuff Out. The deck also includes efficient cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure a consistent draw. The addition of cards like Murktide Regent and Baleful Strix provides additional threats and card advantage to keep up the pressure on the opponent.
